Definition: from G4904; to be a fellow-worker, i.e. co-operate:--help (work) with, work(-er) together.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says we know all things work together for good to those who love God, to those called according to His purpose, and James says faith wrought with Abraham's works, and by works faith was made perfect. The Lord worked with the apostles, confirming the word with signs following, and Paul calls the Corinthians workers together with God. Working together is the shape of God's providence and of His ministry alike.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God works all things together for good for those who love Him, and I believe my working with Him is the way His purpose moves. What grips me most is that He lets me work with Him at all.
